body:
emma_sales: Hey team — ClearBank POC next Wed-Thu. They want a demo with burst capacity for 2 hours each day (heavy reranking). Can we temporarily increase their Dedicated pool headroom by ~6 GPUs? Need pricing/cost delta and any gating (KMS, IP allowlist).

jordan_eng: We can do ephemeral headroom, yes. Two questions: 1) exact windows (start/end UTC) 2) do they need persistent reserved capacity or just burst credits?

emma_sales: Windows: Wed 14:00-16:00 UTC, Thu 14:00-16:00 UTC. Ideally burst only, no long term commit. Also they asked about VPC peering later but that's separate.

jordan_eng: Got it. For burst-only we usually allocate ephemeral capacity via the autoscale "burst_quota" path. We can set burst_quota=6 gpus for those windows and a cooldown of 30m. Would that work?

priya_sre: Quick sec — do we have their KMS vendor and IP ranges? If they're using their KMS for keys in Private deployments we need to collect key ARN + IAM role. For Hosted/Dedicated ephemeral bursts we still need allowlist for the control-plane IPs.

emma_sales: They're using AWS KMS (ClearBank-kms-prod), and public-facing IPs are 18.194.20.0/24 and 3.14.55.0/24. Can you confirm what we need to upload?

mike_platform: For the short demo burst, we can avoid a full KMS integration — we can issue ephemeral API keys scoped to the POC pool. If they insist on KMS, that'll take longer (policy + role setup). Recommend ephemeral keys today, KMS in parallel.

jordan_eng: Agreed. Workflow: 1) create ephemeral Dedicated burst allocation 2) attach pool to their POC project 3) create scoped API key with aggregate token limits and per-route quotas. We can post the key in a secure ticket.

emma_sales: Cool. Cost question from procurement: any surcharge for ephemeral GPU headroom?

finance-bot: Policy: non-committed ephemeral burst is billed at list rate + 20% uplift. If customer signs reserved commit within 30 days, apply a retroactive credit up to the uplift.

emma_sales: Noted. Can we offer a one-time promo credit to cover uplift for this demo to close?

mike_platform: We can offer up to $2k promo credit for first POC if approved by revenue ops. Otherwise standard uplift applies.

emma_sales: I'll ask revenue ops. For the ticketing, can ops-bot create the provisioning ticket? Need it tracked with the metadata: pool size, windows, cooldown, billing flag.

ops-bot: Ticket created: POC-4521. Details: ephemeral_burst=6 gpus; windows=[2024-06-12T14:00Z/2024-06-12T16:00Z,2024-06-13T14:00Z/2024-06-13T16:00Z]; cooldown=30m; billing_code=EPH-BURST. Assignee: jordan_eng.

jordan_eng: Taking it. Next steps from my side: schedule the pool resize, create scoped API key, set burst_quota and cooldown, and add fallback to hosted API in routing policy. Will post the key in the ticket when ready.

priya_sre: I'll prepare a minimal allowlist doc and a checklist for KMS onboarding if they want to pursue that later. Also: confirm they don't need Private/VPC for this demo — if they do, lead time is 2-3 weeks.

emma_sales: They don't need Private for demo. KMS later is fine. One more ask: can the burst be routed to cheaper lower-precision quantized models to save cost while preserving latency?

jordan_eng: Yes — we can route burst traffic to a quantized variant (gptj-q4). We'll add a routing rule: prefer gptj-q4 during burst windows, fallback to full precision outside window. That will reduce cost ~40%.

emma_sales: Perfect. Please keep me posted. Thanks all :thumbsup:

jordan_eng: Will do. ETA for key + pool config: 4 hours after ticket ack.

ops-bot: POC-4521 updated: status=acknowledged, eta=4h, comment="waiting on finance credit approval if requested".

finance-bot: Note: If promo credit requested, please include customer alias and ARR motion in the revenue ops request.

emma_sales: Filed revenue ops request. Tagging @revenue-ops in the ticket.

mike_platform: If anyone needs a quick commands snippet to create a scoped key, use: ```
redwoodctl api-keys create --project clearbank-poc --scopes generate,embed --quota 50000 --expires 2024-06-30
```

emma_sales: Saved. Thanks.

jordan_eng: Done — pool configured, key created and uploaded to ticket POC-4521 (secure). Burst rule and quantized routing applied. Monitoring hooks added to console.

emma_sales: You're a hero. I'll confirm with ClearBank and close loop.

priya_sre: Sending allowlist checklist to ticket.

mike_platform: Leaving a note — if usage spikes beyond burst_quota, requests will failover to hosted API per routing policy. Notify sales if that happens.
